text:
Noel Acciari scored at Madison Square Garden on Thursday off what PHLY Sports' Charlie O'Connor called a "hell of a feed" from Barkey, and the Flyers led 2-1 after two before losing 3-2. That's been the Flyers' month in one game. Acciari has 3 points in 18 games and 40 hits.

He's in Philadelphia for defense. Evolving-Hockey had him in the 98th percentile last season at taking chances away, against competition in the 93rd percentile. This season the Flyers take only 39% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) with him on the ice at five on five, which is hard to square with that profile. They're worse without him, too, so it says as much about the team as about him.

He's 34, undrafted out of Providence, and has played for six NHL teams. He doesn't skate well (4th percentile top speed) and his minutes are down a little lately. We project about 13 goals. He's useful in the lineup for what he prevents, but on a team projected around 75 points, the bigger question is whether the Flyers keep veterans like him as the season slips.
headline: Acciari blocks, hits, and scored Thursday
